Summary of the information you entered
Let's set up your emergency profile. It's ten short questions; the critical information stays available to paramedics who read your card.
Start setting up your health profile
We use your legal name so it matches your medical records.
What is your date of birth
Age changes dosages and treatment protocols.
Use the year, month and day format
The date cannot be later than today
Some clinical reference values depend on this.
What is your mobile phone number
We use it for medication reminders and to verify your account.
Enter your mobile phone number with country code
Enter a valid 10-digit number with country code
Do you know your blood type
It's the first thing a paramedic checks before a transfusion.
I don't know my blood type
Select your blood type or say you don't know it
Are you allergic to any medication
An unnoticed allergy is the most common avoidable cause of harm in an emergency.
Enter the substance or medication that causes your allergy
Select how severe the reaction is
Describe the reaction this substance causes
Enter the name of the allergen
Add your allergies or state that you have none
Do you live with any chronic condition
Conditions such as asthma, diabetes or epilepsy change how you are treated.

Enter the condition before adding it
Add your conditions or state that you have none
Do you take any life-saving rescue medication
These are the medications that save your life in a crisis, such as inhalers, adrenaline or blood thinners.

It speeds up your admission in the emergency room.
